text: A dendritic hexacarboxylate ligand was employed to construct a rht-type copper(II) metal-organic framework (MOF, NTU-105-NH2) under solvothermal conditions.
notes: MOF core synthesis skeleton: name, route, topology, linker.

text: The solvothermal reaction of calcium acetylacetonate and H2NDC gave rise to a metal-organic framework (MOF), {(H 3 O + ) 2 [Ca(NDC)(C 2 H 5 O)(OH)]} 4 ·1.1H2O.
notes: Formula-like MOF name should not be truncated at hydrate decimal points.

text: C-C bonded two-dimensional conjugated covalent organic framework films 2DCCOF1 and 2DCCOF2 were synthesized from aryl diboronic ester and porphyrin monomer by Suzuki polymerization at a water/toluene interface using Pd(PPh3)4 and K2CO3 under argon at 2 °C for one month.
notes: COF Suzuki synthesis skeleton: names, linkage, monomers, catalyst/base, interface, temperature, time.

text: An imine-linked PyTTA-TPA-COF was obtained by Schiff base polycondensation of PyTTA with TPA in mesitylene and 1,4-dioxane at 120 °C for 72 h.
notes: COF imine synthesis skeleton: name, route, linkage, monomers, solvents, temperature, time.

text: A hydrazone-linked TFPPy-DETHz-COF was synthesized by hydrazone formation from 1,3,6,8-tetrakis(4-formylphenyl)pyrene and 2,5-diethoxyterephthalohydrazide in mesitylene/dioxane with acetic acid at room temperature for three days.
notes: COF hydrazone synthesis skeleton: room-temperature conditions and spelled-out duration.

text: Boronate ester COF-5 was synthesized from 1,4-benzenediboronic acid and 2,3,6,7,10,11-hexahydroxytriphenylene through boronate ester condensation in mesitylene and 1,4-dioxane at 85 °C for 72 h.
notes: COF boronate ester synthesis skeleton: boronic acid monomer pair and mixed solvent.

text: An olefin-linked COF-V was prepared by Knoevenagel condensation of 1,3,5-triformylbenzene with 2,4,6-trimethyl-1,3,5-triazine using piperidine in dioxane at 120 °C for 3 days.
notes: COF Knoevenagel synthesis skeleton: olefin linkage and base catalyst.

text: A beta-ketoenamine-linked TpPa-1 COF was synthesized by Schiff-base condensation of 1,3,5-triformylphloroglucinol with p-phenylenediamine in mesitylene/dioxane with 6 M acetic acid at 120 °C for overnight.
notes: COF beta-ketoenamine synthesis skeleton: spaced COF name, acid catalyst, and overnight duration.
